title: Universal optimality of the double-centred matrix under unitarily invariant norms for dissimilarity data
authors: M. Nuria de las Heras Santos
summary: Let $D=(D_{ij})_{i,j=1}^{n}$ be a symmetric dissimilarity matrix and let $D^{(2)}=(D_{ij}^{2})_{i,j=1}^{n}$. We study the affine family of real symmetric matrices \[ A(\mathbf{g})=\tfrac{1}{2}\!\left(\mathbf{1}\mathbf{g}^{\top} +\mathbf{g}\mathbf{1}^{\top}-D^{(2)}\right), \qquad \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{n}, \] parametrised by a free diagonal vector $\mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^n$, whose off-diagonal entries satisfy \[ D_{ij}^{2}=a_{ii}+a_{jj}-2a_{ij}, \qquad i\neq j. \] We prove that the double-centred matrix \[ A(\mathbf{g}^F)=-\tfrac{1}{2}J D^{(2)} J, \qquad…
